LICENSE.scope: Exact top-level file bundled by the release asset; the archive contains no third-party notice inventory proving that this file covers every frontend dictionary/data file.

onnx_metadata.comment: This is Kokoro v1.1-zh, a multilingual TTS model, supporting English, Chinese.

conversion_provenance_limit: The release asset and its digest are exact, but the archive contains no build manifest tying it to an exact sherpa-onnx source commit. The v1.1-zh conversion scripts were introduced in commit dfcbc8d40b222296d855a526f61261b00e0a792d and refactored in commit 59d118c25619e55dc86c482f57c1bfe5049b32d2 shortly after the asset upload; neither should be represented as a cryptographically proven build revision for this asset.
license_provenance_limit: The source model card declares Apache-2.0 and the release archive includes an exact Apache-2.0 top-level LICENSE. The archive also bundles espeak-ng-data and CppJieba-style dictionaries without a complete third-party notice/manifest, so redistribution of the whole extracted archive needs a separate dependency-license audit. This public repository stores only code, reports, hashes, and small generated WAV evidence, not the model archive.
